note: Single source of truth for scene effects in the daily digest. visual-director.js builds its prompt, valid set and data gates from this file; SKILL.md explains how to choose. 'motion' effects take their data in phrase.motionData.

effects.name: titleTakeover
effects.useWhen: the phrase names the story's core in a few words (opening of a segment, a verdict, a product name)
effects.avoidWhen: more than once per segment; long sentences
invariants: fast punch-in with a small settle — never a slow generic fade
the headline holds its exact size and position for the reading hold
kicker is a plain line under an accent rule, never a rounded button
title ≤ 32 characters, 2-5 words

effects.name: keywordCaption
effects.useWhen: an important claim without numbers; 2-3 key words carry the meaning
effects.avoidWhen: the phrase has numbers (use a chart) or a direct quote (use quoteMarker)
invariants: words build in reading order with the voice
only the supplied keywords take the accent colour
two balanced lines, never a third

effects.name: copyCorrection
effects.useWhen: the story corrects a belief, a rumour, an old figure or a reversed decision (was X, now Y)
effects.avoidWhen: there is no real 'wrong' version in the article
invariants: the wrong claim is readable before the strike starts
the strike runs over the text only, then the corrected card arrives
the corrected card is the last thing that moves

effects.name: quoteMarker
effects.useWhen: a named person is quoted in the article and the quote is the news
effects.avoidWhen: the quote is invented or paraphrased by us

example.quote: Vi bygger den største datasenterparken i Europa

invariants: the full quote is readable before the marker sweep
the marker sits behind the highlighted words only
the source line comes last

effects.name: sequentialBars
effects.useWhen: 2-6 values of the same metric over years/companies/countries
effects.avoidWhen: only one number (use counterMosaic) or mixed units
invariants: one shared baseline and one scale for all columns
columns grow one at a time, the counter rides the top edge
only the tallest column takes the accent after all are up

effects.name: ratioBars
effects.useWhen: exactly two values compared and the RATIO is the point (3x cheaper, twice as fast)
effects.avoidWhen: different units
invariants: both bars on one linear scale
the ratio appears only after both bars have landed

effects.name: lineTrend
effects.useWhen: 3-8 points over time where the direction (growth/decline) is the story
effects.avoidWhen: fewer than 3 real data points — never invent points
invariants: points land at their measured positions while the line draws
the dashed trend comes after the observed line, never instead of it

effects.name: compositionStrip
effects.useWhen: market shares or a split of a whole in percent
effects.avoidWhen: values are not parts of one whole
invariants: segments assemble into one continuous 100 % strip
each legend entry appears when its segment lands

effects.name: targetOverrun
effects.useWhen: a result versus a goal, forecast, limit or expectation (beat/missed estimates)
effects.avoidWhen: no explicit target in the article
invariants: the goal line is visible before the fill reaches it
the excess (or shortfall) is treated differently from the part within the goal

effects.name: pipelineFlow
effects.useWhen: how something works step by step, a chain of stages, a rollout order
effects.avoidWhen: dated milestones (use progressTimeline)

data.results: optional 1-3 outcomes fanning out instead of one result

invariants: stages appear in order joined by arrows
the enclosing box draws only after the whole chain exists

effects.name: hubRouting
effects.useWhen: several parties flow into one centre: investors into a startup, suppliers into a platform, partners in a deal
effects.avoidWhen: only one party
invariants: inputs connect to the hub in sequence
the output connector comes last

effects.name: cardCounter
effects.useWhen: several amounts that add up to a total (funding rounds, layoffs per country, fines)
effects.avoidWhen: amounts in different units
invariants: the total changes in lockstep with each card
the summary badge settles after the last card

effects.name: handoffExplain
effects.useWhen: something replaces something else and the story explains what changes (old system → new system, old rule → new rule, CEO change)
effects.avoidWhen: a simple one-word correction (use copyCorrection)

effects.name: timelineNodes
effects.useWhen: 3-5 dated milestones from the article (launch, deadline, regulation steps)
effects.avoidWhen: dates are not in the article

effects.name: funnelAbsorption
effects.useWhen: many inputs end in one outcome (sources → one verdict, many apps → one platform, spam reports → program paused)
effects.avoidWhen: fewer than 3 inputs

effects.name: quadrantPositioning
effects.useWhen: companies/products placed on two dimensions the article actually compares (price vs performance, open vs closed)
effects.avoidWhen: positions would be invented — x/y must follow the article

data.focus: label of the item in focus

effects.name: groupedBars
effects.useWhen: two products/periods compared across 2-3 metrics with different units (price, speed, battery)
effects.avoidWhen: only one metric (use ratioBars)

effects.name: costLedger
effects.useWhen: 2-5 amounts listed and summed (budget lines, fines, costs of a project)
effects.avoidWhen: amounts in different units

effects.name: featureMatrix
effects.useWhen: 2-3 options compared on 2-4 features (plans, products, laws) with text or yes/no values
effects.avoidWhen: one option only

effects.name: percentRing
effects.useWhen: one percentage is the news (share of users, survey result, rate) — optionally against a threshold
effects.avoidWhen: the number is not a percentage

effects.name: cornerTags
effects.useWhen: one central claim with 2-4 short facts around it (who, what, where, how much)
effects.avoidWhen: facts are long sentences

effects.name: statusFocus
effects.useWhen: fact-check or 'what we know': 2-3 claims each with a verdict (confirmed / unclear / not true)
effects.avoidWhen: verdicts are not in the article

effects.name: regionCallout
effects.useWhen: one detail of the article photo or screenshot is the evidence (a line in a document, a part of a device)
effects.avoidWhen: you do not know where in the photo the detail is

effects.name: counterMosaic
effects.useWhen: one hero number with a meaningful label

effects.name: splitScreen
effects.useWhen: two real labelled values side by side (before/after, us/them)

effects.name: dataDashboard
effects.useWhen: several metrics from the article at once

effects.name: iconStagger
effects.useWhen: industries or sectors affected; icons from the fixed list

effects.name: progressTimeline
effects.useWhen: dated milestones from the article

effects.name: globe3D
effects.useWhen: the story is about specific countries or a global rollout

effects.name: photoZoomReveal
effects.useWhen: zoom into a detail of the article photo

effects.name: photoSplitScreen
effects.useWhen: two or three article photos side by side

effects.name: photoCollage
effects.useWhen: several article photos as a collage

effects.name: photoCompareSlider
effects.useWhen: before/after with comparison data

effects.name: photoVerticalScroll
effects.useWhen: a tall image such as a web page or document

effects.name: photoFilterTransition
effects.useWhen: a dramatic reveal: grayscale to color, blur to sharp

effects.name: photoScrollColumns
effects.useWhen: 3+ article photos drifting in columns

effects.name: pixelDissolve
effects.useWhen: transformation stories

effects.name: circuitBoard
effects.useWhen: actual chips/hardware/AI-infrastructure stories only

effects.name: matrixRain
effects.useWhen: actual cybersecurity or hacking stories only

effects.name: alertPulse
effects.useWhen: genuinely urgent or breaking news only

effects.name: noiseWave
effects.useWhen: organic/fluid topics; rarely

effects.name: mosaicGrid
effects.useWhen: rarely; a calm pause
